2125386126617899062.en_summary: CNN reports President Trump is open to pardoning Jensen Huang as the DOJ won't say if it's investigating him, after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Trump says pardon is always an option but probably not necessary. AG Todd Blanche refused to answer on investigation of Nvidia CEO. Quoted Trump comments on pardon, testimony, and possible government $NVDA stake being probably not too late.
2125386126617899062.zh_summary: CNN 報導總統 Trump 開放考慮赦免 Jensen Huang，因司法部未表明是否正在調查他，此前他與疑似中國間諜有婚外情。Trump 表示赦免始終是選項但可能不必要。司法部長 Todd Blanche 拒絕回答有關 Nvidia CEO 調查的問題。引用 Trump 對赦免、作證及可能政府持有 $NVDA 股份「可能還不太晚」的評論。

ticker_notes.NVDA: Trump 開放赦免 Jensen Huang 並考慮政府持股，涉及調查與間諜相關傳聞
